data.name: Ajeem
data.gender_notes: Ajeem is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ajeem is derived from the Sanskrit word 'ajaya', meaning 'invincible' or 'unconquerable'. This name is often given to boys in Hindu tradition, symbolizing strength, courage, and determination. The name Ajeem carries the meaning “Strong, Invincible” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ajeem usually hope their child will grow to embody strong, invincible and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Ajeem belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Strong, Invincible.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ajeem total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
